_comment: vmov_cmp standalone DC probe (issue #189): operating point + settled VCTRL sweep of the
committed VCTRL-movement sensor at the reduced_set corners (tt/ss/ff, composed by
sim/harness/gridspec.py --reduced-set; no corner value restated here). NOT a graded spec
result (sim/corners.json: the reduced set is never a recorded result) and NOT the tt smoke
gate -- sim/lock-detector-smoke/requests/ld.request.json is untouched. This is the
diagnostic slice of #148: why does `still` never assert at ss on the committed smoke
stimulus (issue #145 probe results/20261115T185846Z-probe/)?
Analysis: .dc sweep of the Vctrl source, 0..1.32 V at 5 mV (0.585/0.600/0.615/0.850 are
on-grid). In DC the low-pass cap is open, so vsb = vsb0 = vsa: the sweep varies the OTA

Corner units: the reduced set (gridspec --reduced-set) with the lock-detector bench's own passive sections added (cornerRES res_typ + cornerCAP cap_typ, exactly the sections sim/lock-detector-smoke/requests/ld.request.json carries beside its MOS section, per sim/corners.json whose corner axes are MOS x supply x temperature only).
pair's common-mode input and STILL(VCTRL) is the sensor's quiet window. Operating points
are read with FIND ... AT=<VCTRL> at the quiet smoke input 0.600 V, the ripple band edges
0.585/0.615 V, and the documented ~0.85 V validity ceiling.
Transitions: WHEN <out>=v(half) (50 % of the corner's own rail) rise=1/fall=1 over the
sweep; an errored WHEN card is the measurement's report that no such transition exists.
still_max_085/still_min_085 bracket STILL over the documented validity window [0, 0.85] V.
The OTA tail currents cannot be carried by any klt sim measurement form as shipped
(2AMLogic/klayout-tools#6997); i(vdd) (the block's whole supply current through its VDD
pin) and the internal node voltages are recorded instead.
/home/ubuntu/share/pdk/ihp-sg13g2/libs.tech/ngspice/osdi is substituted at staging. Simulated, never measured.

measurements.name: still_max_085
measurements.spice: .meas dc still_max_085 max v(still) from=0 to=0.85

measurements.name: still_min_085
measurements.spice: .meas dc still_min_085 min v(still) from=0 to=0.85
